implementation_phase: Only source, cases and protocol are prepared. No Cargo/rustfmt/test/viewer/oracle execution is authorized in this phase.

steam_drive_diagnostic.scope: Prior diagnostic limits, including independently initialized state. A failure remains a failure and does not become an extension-parity claim.

own_model_limits.seed_replay: exact forces and state for identical path/input/seed

native_methods: AirSinglePipe.PropagateBrakePressure (three original freight-car subsystems, head pipe1 only prescribed)
MSTSSteamLocomotive via original Simulator.SetExplore/Start/Update (50 ms); numeric initialized hardware, actual controllers and full output phases

native_scope.steam_properties: Equivalent interpolation only. Rigid vessel/Rankine cycle and compound receiver are explicitly Rust models, not full MSTSSteamLocomotive parity.
native_scope.emergency: Original legacy RF numeric profile plus labeled modern dump/quick-action variants; single-car pipe1/pipe3 prescribed and separate three-car PropagateBrakePressure with only head pipe1 prescribed. All remaining pipe pressures, reservoirs, valves and cylinders evolve. No claim of locomotive feed-valve/DP/two-pipe completeness.
native_scope.nadal: Existing native lateral indication stays unchanged. Persistent off-rail consequences are a Rust extension.
native_scope.steam_drive: Real original locomotive/PAT closed-loop diagnostic. Rust evolves independently using the same static initialized hardware and controls, with a predeclared own finite-volume cycle. Compare initial/fire/load/injection/coast/braking, report every phase and retain failures. Never prescribe native speed, force, pressure, heat or flow to Rust.

extensions_without_native_equivalent: two-rail roughness and unilateral quarter-car contact
phase_requirements: independent double heading and compound bypass
SteamDrive independent initial factories plus per-phase pressure/production/steam/coal/injection/tender/force/motion errors
wine_policy: OracleWine only; fresh marked private prefix; Graphics=null, ShowCrashDialog=0 verified; no inherited user displays/audio; exact-prefix cleanup receipt.
baseline_policy: New directories only. No approved references, source/DLL originals or six human traces may be rewritten.
